_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: output_html pages are views too. The agent has shown, in the conversation /c/{{SLUG}}, a page with output_html and the excalidraw library: "the view" is the frame ".output-iframe-tool iframe". The page has #theme, #font and #libs, and the buttons #pick (sets the context for the model to "The user picked blue"), #send (asks to send "echo: sent from the page" as the user's message, then shows how that went in #sent) and #save (asks to download colors.txt, holding "blue", then shows how that went in #saved). Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The consent bar" is data-testid "mcp-app-consent", where the host asks the user's OK for links and downloads a view asks for. "The text box" is data-testid "message-input", and "the draft label" data-testid "view-draft", which shows above the text box while it holds a message a view asked to send. To "send T": fill data-testid "message-input" with T and click data-testid "send-button". "The agent says T": the last ".message-agent" whose text contains T should be visible (timeout 30s). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. The view's #theme should have exactly the text "theme light". 2. Themed by default: eval, in the page, getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--font-sans").trim(), saving it as FONT: the view's #font should have exactly the text {{FONT}}. 3. Its libraries come to it, and only to it, like the host's messages: the view's #libs should have exactly the text "excalidraw". 4. Click the view's #pick. Send "app context?": the agent says "The user picked blue". 5. Click the view's #send. The text box should have the value exactly "echo: sent from the page", and the draft label exactly the text "From Predictable view". Click data-testid "send-button". The ".message-user" whose text contains "echo: sent from the page" should be visible, and the view's #sent should have exactly the text "sent". 6. Click the view's #save. The consent bar should contain the text "colors.txt (4 B)", and no download should have begun yet. One request at a time: click the view's #save again; the view's #saved should contain the text "waiting for the user", and the consent bar should still be visible. Click the consent bar's button named "Save": a download whose suggested file name is exactly "colors.txt" should begin, and the view's #saved should have exactly the text "saved". 7. Emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark. The view's #theme should have exactly the text "theme dark".
